scope: Local no-topoff He63 plus HeII nonlinear statistical equilibrium at the supplied non-root native seed; all external conditions are fixed.

fixed: T, ne, H populations, HeIII, metal populations, total HeI+HeII, mass, geometry and the original complete signed external radiation packets.
model.solved: 63 log population ratios in each of eight cells, with complete positive 64-state kinetic rates and a GTH target; HeII colliders and finite-column line destruction/recapture update between iterations.
model.native_charge_transfer: H capture uses bound H[0], while total neutral H stays in the C23 collider cutoffs. Both saved native metal-He CT rates enter the ground charge pair exactly once.
model.continuum: Bare full-Milne spontaneous/induced capture, CI/three-body source LTE convention and DR capture. No escape-weighted capture or topoff.
model.kinetic_heat: Positive collision heat/cooling follows the signed actual level-energy direction. Source-style absolute-pair-energy results are preserved separately.
model.lower_boundary: The first two native atomic-LTE cells are diagnostic SE here; no production lower-LTE boundary is replaced.

original_He63_corrections.charge_scope: Earlier charge percentages used only H/He processes. The corrected comparator includes ground-H and the exact saved native metal-He charge-transfer rates.
original_He63_corrections.note: Common fixed-reservoir CT terms leave the net comparison unchanged to roundoff, but its gross denominator and relative percentages must use the complete comparator. Original artifacts remain unchanged.

energy_convention.cause: Three HeI 2^3P pairs decrease in actual energy with index; C23 stores absolute pair energy and applies index-based collision heat, while inverse collision coefficients use signed energy. This is an energy-direction inconsistency, not ordinary rounding.
energy_convention.radiative_limit: Source photon frequencies and radiative rates remain unchanged. Their tiny signed-level energy defect is separately quantified in the independent sign review; no global exact radiative-energy consistency claim.

interpretation: HeII changes by up to 4.247 times relative to its trace initial density, but its maximum density increase divided by fixed ne is 8.9997e-7. This is a dimensionless conditional density correction, not an updated electron solution.
The maximum kinetic heat change is 3.3342e-7 of the original atmosphere positive heating+cooling scale; line and two-photon emission remain separate photon forcing.

Excited-He bound-free column optical depth is 1.11e-11. The approximately 19.3 percent local opacity change includes ground atomic cross-section replacement and is not an actual photo-rate or spectrum error.
Native ground-HeII to HeIII leakage under the unchanged field is explicitly computed but not included in the closed 64-state system.

titanium.scope: Fixed-population supplied-seed Ti numerical follow-up; no coupled atmospheric response.
titanium.worst_photo_channel: Cell0 TiIII ground photoionization; not the TiII fraction or line strength.

four_charge.scope: The added upward channel includes photoionization, collisional ionization and proton charge exchange; sourcecoefficients use stored warm/hot C23 q3 readouts.

limits: Native populations/temperature/densities fixed; only continuum grid projection and transfer are re-evaluated. Other photon packets and line pumping retain their supplied-state values.
All-cell passive Ti SE does not replace the prescribed production lower LTE boundary.
No Ti feedback on radiation, electrons, mass, thermal flow or observer; no parameter-domain or high-stage convergence claim.
Native non-root seed T/ne/H/HeIII, total HeI+HeII nuclei, mass, geometry and external signed radiation packets.
All eight cells use diagnostic statistical equilibrium; no production lower-LTE boundary is replaced.
No HeII to HeIII transitions are part of this closed 64-state system; their unbalanced leakage is reported separately.
No-topoff He63 with full-Milne capture/cooling from independently qualified bare cross sections; source C23 LTE convention only for CI/three-body.
No updated global attenuation, free-bound emission, two-photon spectrum, thermal structure, wind, or observer.
Both spontaneous two-photon channels enter populations and radiation forcing; induced two-photon remains off and no spectrum is returned.
DR capture is included, its inverse remains unimplemented and bounded separately.
He charge-transfer heat remains zero, matching the existing native/C23 convention; no invented kinetic CT term is added.
Density correction divided by fixed ne is dimensionless; ne was not updated and charge neutrality was not solved.
HeIII leakage is a separate ground-HeII diagnostic under the original external field, not an included transition or a full excited-HeII model.
No full-atmosphere equilibrium, revised lower boundary, global radiation response, observer or NUTS validation.
preserved_failures: The original softmax-roundtrip same-population parity failure is retained. Supplying the exact same population array gives all line operators bitwise agreement; collider rates differ only 2.67e-16.
Both source-style He64 energy gates remain failed; the signed-level kinetic ledger is a separately named correction, not a relaxed tolerance.
H/He-only and ground-H-only intermediate versions remain separate immutable results.
publication: Aggregate scalars and provenance only; raw arrays, local prototypes and all new reference archives remain local.
